title: a new empty or comment-only catch with no reason
how: JS files the diff touches: a catch block or .catch(() => {}) whose body is empty or only comments; the comment is a reason only when it says what happens next (two words or more) and does not start with a deny-list word

explain.what: A new catch block is empty, or holds only a comment that does not say what happens next.
explain.why: An empty catch hides the error. The code goes on as if the step worked, and the real fault shows up later, far from its cause.
explain.fix: Handle the error, rethrow it, or let it go up. If it is safe to drop, write a comment that says why and what happens next (two words or more, not "ignore" or "ok").
